name: praxis
description: Spec-driven software engineering workflows for turning ideas into clarified specs, tested code, and verified changes.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven workflows for clarifying, designing, implementing, reviewing, and verifying software changes
interface.longDescription: Praxis brings its staged software engineering workflow to Codex. It includes reusable skills for clarifying intent, slicing features, sketching design, driving TDD, reviewing code, improving changes, and verifying behavior, plus `craft` and `forge` workflow skills that adapt the original Claude slash commands for Codex.
defaultPrompt: Clarify this feature and turn it into a testable spec before coding.
Split this large feature into thin vertical slices I can ship incrementally.
Drive this change with the full Praxis craft workflow.
